parameters.query: SELECT fe.id, fe.source_url, fe.evidence_name, fe.source_platform, fe.hash_sha256, fe.tenant_id, fe.custody_log, mv.storage_path AS original_path FROM forensic_evidence fe LEFT JOIN master_vault mv ON mv.tenant_id = fe.tenant_id WHERE fe.verification_status IN ('matched', 'verified') AND (fe.watermark_checked IS NULL OR fe.watermark_checked = false) LIMIT 10

UPDATE forensic_evidence SET watermark_checked = true, watermark_signature = '{{ $json.watermark_text }}', traitor_trace_id = '{{ $json.traitor_trace_id }}', verification_status = 'traitor_identified', custody_log = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.custody_log) }}'::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.evidence_id }}'

UPDATE forensic_evidence SET watermark_checked = true, watermark_signature = NULL, traitor_trace_id = NULL, custody_log = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.custody_log) }}'::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.evidence_id }}'
